item.title: Ask HN: How do you keep up with HN these days?
item.description:

🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49308059

item.title: The End of Mathematics
item.description:
📝 What I find striking here is that there are both fewer questions and fewer answers. No one, not even the author, is reading much of this work. I've recently been told by multiple colleagues that they are unwilling to discuss work in progress for this reason.
🔗 Read more: https://www.daniellitt.com/blog/2026/8/11/the-end-of-mathematics

item.title: Racket v9.3
item.description:
📝 The error-syntax->srcloc-handler parameter provides control over the mapping from syntactic forms to source locations for error handling. The file/zip package provides a new mechanism for greatly increased control over zip file generation, allowing in-memory file sources and per-file compression control. Racket is a community developed open source project and we welcome new contributors.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.racket-lang.org/2026/08/racket-v9-3.html
